title: Grateful Dead Live at Jahrhunderthalle on 1972-04-26

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a high‑energy Frankfurt ’72 show with smoking Good Lovin’, The Other One, Jack Straw and China>Rider.
ai_review.review: The outtake collection from the April 26 1972 Jahrhunderthalle concert delivers a solid performance that many fans rank among the best of Euro ’72.  Standout moments include an inspired Good Lovin', a legendary Other One suite, and tight renditions of Jack Straw, China>Rider and Uncle John’s Band, all presented on a generally clean soundboard mix (though some hiss is audible).

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive 5‑star comments praising both the music and the mix, with only a few moderate criticisms (hiss, set grading). The weight of enthusiastic reviews yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and clean; reviewers note excellent mix and clear vocals/instruments. A few mention slight tape hiss, but no major drop‑outs or balance problems.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set rated B+ by some listeners, second set a solid C; the second‑set jam suite (Truckin' → The Other One) is highlighted as a tour‑defining high point.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar is repeatedly praised – “perfect tone,” “shredding,” and “weaving magic” especially on Good Lovin' and The Other One.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass work gets strong nods – “great theme,” “Phil bombs,” and leading the jam in The Other One.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir is noted for rocking out on Sugar Magnolia and delivering solid rhythm/vocals throughout.
